runs.name: ASML Holding N.V.; Euronext Amsterdam ASML.AS and Nasdaq ASML, Dutch, 20-F filer, reports in euros; lithography systems, the only maker of EUV scanners, and installed-base service
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Run at the operator's word ("re run all under v5", the names still carrying v4.1 bands), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, three analysts in parallel (ASML, PLTR, SNPS), lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **EUR 1,424.80** (Amsterdam, 2026-10-26, aggregator, flagged; Nasdaq $1,571.80 on 2026-10-23) x **384.1M shares** (one class; 20-F FY2025 `0001628280-26-011378` and the 2026 interim count) = cap **EUR 547.3B**; sovereign **3.62%** (ECB 30-year, the earnings currency). Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): today's winner can be named (the only EUV maker; Canon and Nikon in DUV only), its 2035 earning power cannot: how much lithography future processes use (the filer's own risk factor, "architectures that rely less on lithography"), High NA's adoption and price (still in qualification at end-2025), and export rules on China (29.1% of 2025 sales, 36.1% of 2024). The insiders' own record: 2025 revenue modelled in 2018 at EUR 15 to 24B, actual 32.7B; 2026 guidance moved from EUR 34 to 39B in January to 44 to 45B in October. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (EUR M) 10,257, 7,834, 4,569, 10,075, 11,430 (2021 to 2025, maintenance case, D&A as the guess), mean 8,833; all spending mean 7,947; range **EUR 661 to 808 a share all-equity** ($740 to $904 at ECB 1.1193), equity-only 635 to 782; fair price **EUR 272 all-equity** ($304; equity-only EUR 246); 1.6% to 2.1% expected at the price, and Q7 would have closed OUT on the floor. Competitors (average operating margin FY2016 to FY2025, own filings): ASML 29.9%, AMAT 26.9%, LRCX 27.5%, KLAC about 35.7% (a proxy about 1.7 points high); Canon, Nikon and Zeiss not filers. Facts after the stop: four customers 61.2% of 2025 sales; Zeiss SMT the sole optics source and lent EUR 2.1B at 0.01% to 1%; customer down payments EUR 1.8B to 19.4B, about equal to equity; net cash about EUR 10.0B; buybacks with no stated price, 2024 to 2025 prices (about EUR 870 and 715) above the computed bottom; quarterly guidance given and beaten. Conventions confessed: Zeiss loans and the Mistral AI stake left out of owner cash. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; four pathspec commits, own paths only. Contamination declared: other runs' commit subjects and `Screens/` file names; none concerned ASML, none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held (sold 2026-08-28). No v5 alert (closed before Q7); the v4.1 bands ASML-early-warning and ASML-reentry-band retired at this fold by hand (their quote ticker ASML.AS is not matched by the fold tool).
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1: the only EUV maker, but its 2035 earnings turn on lithography's share of future processes, High NA's adoption and China's export rules, and the company's own forecasts have missed by half. Computation only: range EUR 661 to 808 all-equity vs EUR 1,424.80, fair EUR 272. Sold 2026-08-28 under v4.1; this v5 run gives no re-entry alert.
